prompt:
You are a precise annotation engine for a stationary radar/overhead camera view. Silently locate EVERY object in the image.
Classes (name): 0=Car, 1=robotcar.
Then output ONLY lines, one per object: class_name cx cy w h
- class_name is the exact class name string (e.g. robotcar)
- cx cy w h are floats in [0,1] normalized by image width/height, 4+ decimals
- one TIGHT box per object; objects may be small
Example output:
robotcar 0.5123 0.4311 0.0540 0.0380
If there are no objects output exactly: NONE
